Supplier Summary

The Supplier Summary report provides a comprehensive overview of all supplier activity during a specified period.

This report helps you track amounts owed to suppliers and monitor payment patterns across your supplier base.

Report Components

The report displays the following information for each supplier:

• Opening balance - The amount owed at the beginning of the reporting period

• Invoices - Total value of purchase invoices received during the period

• Payments - Total payments made to suppliers

• Refunds - Any refunds received from suppliers

• Debit notes - Adjustments reducing amounts owed to suppliers

• Journal entries - Manual adjustments affecting supplier balances

• Closing balance - The final amount owed at the end of the reporting period

Currency Handling

When working with multiple currencies, the report groups suppliers by currency to provide accurate totals.

Each currency group displays subtotals, making it easy to see your total liability in each currency.

To customize this report, see: Supplier Summary
